text: Fix the retry against the verifier's findings: (1) reconcile.rs also builds landing records through GitLandingRecords, so update it for the content classification and make the 5 failing reconcile tests pass (cargo test -p athena-core reconcile::); (2) the owner-path fixture may use any directory name with a nested .gitattributes holding '* athena-exclude' (owner-notes/ is fine); do not name the word the boundary scan bans, and drop that part of the earlier criterion; (3) audit every caller of GitLandingRecords and pr_commits, including reconcile.rs and drain.rs.
